workload_summary: Regulated internal LLM use for analyst workflows (case summarization, policy/Q&A, ticket triage) + customer-support assist. Sensitive data. requirements_summary: Private deployment in customer AWS VPC. Needs: (1) customer-managed encryption keys (AWS KMS) for backups and storage targets, (2) audit logging with defined retention and export, (3) documented backup/restore runbooks + DR testing plan, (4) retention controls aligned to internal policy (1 year searchable, 7 years archive), (5) procurement timeline with clear evidence artifacts (SOC 2, pen test summary, encryption design).
audit_logging_notes: They asked specifically: can we prove immutable audit trail for admin actions in Private? Requirement: export control-plane audit logs to their SIEM and keep at least 12 months online + 7 years archived. They also asked if we can include backup/restore events (backup started/succeeded/failed, restore executed, maintenance mode toggled) in the audit stream. They want a clear list of event types + fields and confirmation that secrets/keys are not logged.
backup_encryption_notes: Key question from CISO: "At no point should Redwood possess or be able to decrypt our backups." They want CMK-only. Asked whether encryption is server-side (SSE-KMS) vs client-side, and what we recommend for air-gapped variants (they have one BCP site with restricted connectivity, not fully air-gapped today). Need written statement re: key custody boundaries + rotation expectations. Also asked about break-glass access patterns for restore assistance (prefer customer-controlled role with approvals + audit).
retention_and_data_residency_notes: Residency: US-only (no cross-region replication outside us-east/us-west). Retention: (a) backups: minimum 35 days standard, with quarterly snapshots kept 1 year; (b) audit logs: 7 years archived. They want ability to hold backups longer for legal hold. Requested support for lifecycle policies on storage targets and documentation on how retention pruning avoids deleting 'latest known good'.
dr_and_rpo_rto_notes: They requested RPO/RTO guidance tied to cost. Early target discussed: RPO <= 1 hour for control plane DB, RTO <= 4 hours for full Private control plane restore to a new cluster/VPC. They want at least one witnessed restore drill before signing production order form. Also want explicit sequencing: maintenance mode -> quiesce writes -> DB restore/PITR -> artifacts -> validation gates -> exit maintenance mode.

They prefer a single packaged 'evidence bundle' PDF + links to operator docs/runbooks.
